structure.description: 单一演讲主题占据首要层级，辅助信息退居边缘，建立开场气势。

subject_rules.primary: use one concise title as the dominant visual element

zones: around the title and at the lower edge

visual_flow.primary: title first, then subtitle and presenter detail

generation.style: one thought per opening slide, decisive hierarchy, restrained support information
